title: My Parking Lot
description: Welcome to "My Parking Lot," the ultimate puzzle challenge! Navigate through a chaotic mess of cars stuck in a parking lot and strategize to safely remove each vehicle without crashing them into each other. Your goal? Clear the parking lot by guiding all the cars to the exit, unlocking new levels as you master the art of precision parking. Can you untangle the traffic and solve each puzzle with finesse? Test your skills in "My Parking Lot" now!

title: Hidden Objects
description: Hidden Objects is a visually stunning puzzle game that challenges your observation skills. Explore beautifully detailed scenes filled with cleverly hidden items. Use hints if needed, but the real reward lies in uncovering every object on your own. Dive into a world of mystery and sharpen your perception.

title: Pixel Path
description:
Pixel Path is a platformer with a non—standard plot.?
Get to the portal at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem... The floor may collapse, the spikes will move on you, and your character will grow to huge sizes. One wrong step and the game is over.❌
You will have to keep your sanity, expect surprises, show a good reaction and most importantly: do not get angry.?
The game also has a table of the best players who completed all levels faster than the rest.

title: Sorting Balls
description: Sorting Balls is a fun and challenging puzzle game where players must sort colored balls into the correct tubes. The goal is to organize all the balls by color using logical thinking and strategic moves. As the levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring careful planning. With simple controls and engaging mechanics, Sorting Balls is perfect for players who enjoy brain-teasing challenges.

title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
description: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

title: Magic Tiles 3
description:
Love music games? Play your favorite songs on Piano Magic Piles 3!
Magic Tiles 3 is an engaging music game that combines magic piano, rhythm, and games for a fun and immersive experience. Tap the tiles to the beat, challenge your reflexes, and enjoy a massive library of 45,000+ songs across various genres, pop, EDM, hip-hop, and more! Tap the black tiles to the rhythm while avoiding the white ones.
Support email: magictiles3.support@amanotes.com

title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Street of Secrets is an atmospheric hidden object game where you become the lead detective. A mysterious case awaits, and your insightful assistant is there to help, offering hints and guiding you to crucial details.

title: Fruit Ninja
description: Welcome to the dojo, ninja. Your objective: become a master of slicing fruit! What better way to do that than play Fruit Ninja, the original hit fruit-slicing mobile game? ? Unsheathe your blade and start the juicy carnage with the three classic game modes that billions of players have come to know and love.

title: Pixel Shoot
description: Pixel Shoot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game. It's simple to play by just tapping the cannons. Make sure you pay attention to the color and base your strategy around it. You must also manage your capacity, and timing is key! Send your cannons in the right order, manage the flow, and maximize your score.

title: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets is an exciting hidden object game where magic and time intertwine in a thrilling adventure. Everything changed when a mysterious magical crystal activated, scattering objects across time! You'll enter a world of riddles, hidden objects, and temporal paradoxes.

title: Golf Orbit
description:
One shot golf simulator is the battle of golf rivals to become the golf king worldwide. Become part of this idle golf orbit rocket league in which balls go high to Mars. Smash the ball to mars and become the golf champions.

Oneshot Golf Orbit is golf offline game which has many golf rocket leagues and one shot golf battles. Be part Mars golf games to become champions of golfing over it.

title: Slice it All
description:
In this game, you need to slice obstacles ahead of you! Tap to flip your knife and neatly slice various obstacles on your path into equal halves! This is the juiciest way and become the slice master!

Armed with your super sharp knife, no obstacle can stop you! Flip your knife at the right time and slice various obstacles – pencils, pipes, anvils, and the list goes on!

title: Hidden Object: My Hotel
description: Hidden Objects: My Hotel – A fun hidden-object game where you help a young woman restore her dream hotel! After buying the old building, she needs your help to clean up cluttered rooms, find hidden items, and bring back its lost charm.

title: Arrow Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced and strategic arrow challenge in Arrow Escape, an addictive arrows puzzle escape game built for players who love logic puzzles and intense puzzle escape moments.

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!

title: Clash Crowd Game
description: Clash Crowd Game is an addictive arcade runner game where you tap to run, survive obstacles, and reach the destination. Control your crowd, avoid traps, and face thrilling challenges in every level. Easy controls, engaging gameplay, and colorful 3D graphics make this game perfect for quick fun. Run smart, grow your crowd, and prove your survival skills.

title: Puzzle Wood Block
description:
Put the given blocks of pattern in 9x9 squares to fill them.
Once the 9x9 slots are all Filled up, the blocks in it will be cleared!
Achieve high score by clearing many combos at once!

title: Color Block Jam
description: Color Block Jam – an exciting puzzle game! Move the colored blocks, solve logic challenges, and complete levels. The game has many levels, from simple tasks to real brain teasers.

title: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries
description: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries is a relaxing hidden object game set in cozy interiors. Solve mysteries with a detective, accompanied by soothing melodies.

title: From Nerd To School Popular
description: Embark on a transformation journey “From Nerd To School Popular”! Help our protagonist navigate high school life, overcome challenges, and discover their true potential. With your guidance, they’ll undergo a stylish makeover, gain confidence, and rise to the top of the social ladder. Experience the ultimate high school makeover story and watch as our hero transforms from a shy outsider to a beloved school icon!

title: Obby On a Bike
description: Obby On a Bike, a thrilling bike-riding platformer that combines exciting obstacle courses with fun parkour gameplay! It features two exciting gameplay modes: Normal and Challenge. In Normal mode, you can carefully ride through each level without the stress of a timer. Challenge mode lets you test your speed and skill as you race against time. Whether you're playing alone or competing head-to-head in the 2 Player mode, there's always a thrilling challenge awaiting you!

title: Magic Flow
description: Magci Flow are puzzle series solved by transferring liquids. Players must strategically use container capacities to sort liquids in the fewest moves. Tasks include merging same-colored liquids or precise sequencing, rigorously testing judgment skills.

title: Zumbo Mania
description: Get better at marble shooting and try to complete all the levels with three stars in each level. This marble game is easy to play and addicting at the same time.

title: Wooden bolts and nuts
description: As you play, you'll find tangled screws, nuts, bolts, plates, rings, ropes, and more. Find out how to solve the riddle. It's not just a game, it's a journey through the many fun nuts and bolts of the game.

title: Helix Jump
description:
Helix Jump is a game with simple and addictively fun mechanics. In the game, you guide a bouncing ball continuously down a series of circular platforms. Fall through the cracks and avoid landing in the forbidden zones!

This is a simple yet challenging game with harmonious and colorful interface to provide players with a comfortable visual experience.

Features:
One-tap easy-to-learn controls, rich visual effects and addictive gameplay mechanics.

title: My Arcade Center 2
description:
My Arcade Center 2 is a fast-paced arcade management tycoon game.

Build, customize, and expand your own arcade across 7 unique maps. Earn by day, upgrade by night, unlock new machines, hire staff, optimize layouts, and grow your business. Switch between centers anytime, unlock new characters and skins, complete daily missions, and boost your long-term progress with rewarding upgrades.

title: Summer Rider 3D
description: Hit the waves in Summer Rider 3D, a sun-soaked surf adventure inspired by high-speed endless runners. Glide over water on a surfboard or jet-ski, collect shimmering starfish, and push your reflexes to the limit as the speed cranks up. With a colorful summer theme and upbeat tropical soundtracks, the game offers endless fun for both solo and 2 player mode!

title: Toilet Pin
description: Join the daily story of the toilet boy in the monster letter world. This new pin pulling game is for you. Let's explore Alphabet Lore with extraordinary characters! In the land of evil letters, you will have a chance to meet various amazing characters and powers of them: evil B ready to punch in your face, Angry C biting with sharp teeth, boring F with a gun, Crazy Z with fire, monster D who loves lava ....

title: Wonders of Egypt Mahjong
description: Wonders of Egypt Mahjong transports you to the mystical world of Ancient Egypt in this brand-new Solitaire Mahjong game. Play through beautifully designed hand-drawn tiles featuring Egyptian motifs and captivating backgrounds inspired by the wonders of Egypt. With 40 unique new layouts and three smaller tutorial layouts, it’s perfect for both beginners and Mahjong experts. Dive into hours of challenging gameplay and uncover the secrets of the Pharaohs!

title: Pizza Tycoon
description: Play as Boss Hei Wa, running a pizza shop! Serve food, collect payments, hire and upgrade staff, and expand sales channels. Manage and grow your business to success!

title: Tricky Life
description:
Welcome to Tricky Life, the funniest brain test puzzle game ever made!
Here, logic meets laughter every level is designed to make you giggle, think twice, and smile when you finally find the answer.

title: No Pain No Gain - Ragdoll Sandbox
description: A ragdoll sandbox physics game where you place traps, cause pain, and earn coins for every hit. The more it hurts, the more you get.

title: Obby Rainbow Tower
description: Obby Rainbow Tower is a fast, winter-themed tower race where every second and every jump matters. Each floor is packed with moving platforms, icy tiles, spinning lava bars, surprise snowstorms and snowball portals that try to knock you into the void.  You can replay the tower as many times as you like, trying to beat your own best time or racing a friend side by side in 2 player mode.

title: Northern Lights - the secret of the forest
description:
A new hit for fans of the Match 3 game genre!

The Scientist Cat is already hiding items throughout the mysterious forest so you can enjoy finding things and earn as many emeralds as possible. The cat is happy to have new guests!

title: Woolloop! Color Puzzle
description: Knit Color Flow is a cozy yarn game where soft wool, gentle motion, and colorful puzzles blend into a peaceful experience. Watch the bobbins glide across conveyor belts as patterns slowly take shape, creating a world full of balance and visual harmony. The calm atmosphere, smooth animations, and comforting design invite you to relax while enjoying a steady sense of flow from the very first level.

title: Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY
description: Welcome to Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY, the ultimate playground for those who love to personalize, design, and express their unique style!

title: World Cup Soccer Caps
description: World Cup Soccer Caps is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Tape Sort 3D
description: Tape Sort 3D is a captivating puzzle game available on Android that invites players to engage in a unique untaping experience.

title: Italian Brainrot Obby Parkour
description:
Italian Brainrot Obby Parkour is a wild and hilarious 2 player platforming experience that blends meme-fueled chaos with classic obby parkour mechanics. Inspired by games like Tower of Hell, this title brings the unpredictable humor of the Italian brainrot meme universe into a 3D climbing challenge.

Available characters are: 
-Tung Tung Sahur
-Brr Brr Patapim
-Burbaloni Luliloli
-Frigo Camelo
-Girafa Celestre
-Lirili Larila
-Orangutini Annaucini
-Tralalero Tralala
-Vaca Saturno Saturnita

title: Crazy Motorcycle
description:
Drive Nubik along exciting tracks. Jump over gaps, go around obstacles and reach the finish line! Lots of different levels, drive a motorcycle, get there without destruction.

You have to drive a motorcycle with a noob and get to the finish line.
Jump over gaps and go around obstacles at high speed.
Exciting levels are waiting for you!

title: Paws Off My Clues!
description:
Explore unique locations filled with hidden objects and unexpected mysteries. From sunny beaches to the ancient ruins of Persia, every corner of this fluffy world comes to life as you hunt for hidden treasures.

Watch as the cats go about their lives, adding charm and humor to the atmosphere, while you search through their delightful mess. Solve puzzles, progress through levels, and become the ultimate hidden object master!

title: Italian Brainrot Bike Rush
description: Hop on for chaotic fun in Italian Brainrot Bike Rush, a meme-filled obby bike platformer. Pick from 5 absurd meme legends and ride through floating platforms, deadly traps, and wild jumps. Play 5 levels across 3 modes—Normal, Challenge, and One Life. Collect coins, unlock checkpoints, and conquer brainrot chaos. Perfect for fans of meme-based bike racing and Italian brainrot platformers!

title: Tales of Lagoona
description: Embark on a magical Hidden Object adventure beneath the waves! In Coral Bay, the New Anemone Orphanage is in danger of closing – only you can save it. Search beautiful underwater scenes for hidden treasures, sell your finds at the market, upgrade the orphanage, play 160 mini-games, and take on quests from the townsfolk. Join Islabelle the Mermaid in a heartwarming quest to rescue the orphans!

title: Rooftop Run
description: Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.

title: Labuba Merge
description: Labuba Merge is a fun and relaxing casual merge game where you combine adorable fluffy Labuba to unlock bigger, cuter, and funnier versions! Perfect for kids and adults, this addicting merge puzzle game will challenge your strategy and bring a smile to your face. Just drag, drop, and merge your Labubas to evolve them into new forms. How big can your Labuba grow?

title: Nonogram Jigsaw
description:
Discover the mystery of Nonogram! A large number of puzzles are waiting for you to solve, a lot of puzzles are waiting for you to complete, and various themes are waiting for you to unlock.
The difference is that this game can play puzzles and nonograms at the same time. Each time you pass a level, you can get a piece of puzzle piece, and finally you can unlock a lot of beautiful pictures. Train your brain from the basic rules and logic behind the picture cross puzzle!

title: Slingshot Fortress
description: Slingshot Fortress is an addictive 2D physics-based destruction game where precision, timing, and strategy are essential. Use your slingshot to launch stones, bombs, and shurikens to destroy towers, collapse structures, and uncover hidden enemies. Explore vibrant levels from forests to icy lands, unlock powerful abilities, trigger explosive chain reactions, and master increasingly challenging puzzles in this fun, casual browser game experience.

title: Pixel Fun Color By Number
description: Pixel Fun - Color By Number is a fun coloring game that lets you bring pixel art to life. With casual number-based instructions, you’ll fill in each pixel square to reveal stunning artwork.Each image is divided into tiny pixels. Each is assigned a number that corresponds to a color. For example, click on the city scene to fill in color and light up the street.

title: Find Hidden Cats
description: Explore charming black-and-white scenes inspired by iconic European cities in this relaxing yet addictive hidden object game. Every corner is packed with clever details and playful surprises - can you spot all 20 mischievous cats hiding in plain sight? Test your observation skills, take your time, and enjoy the satisfying thrill of discovering each well-hidden feline!

title: Build an Aquapark
description:
? Welcome to the craziest water park! ?

Build your own dream water slide and ride it at full speed! Buy parts, combine them however you like, and create the longest, fastest, and craziest tracks in the game.

title: Crazy Bus Station
description: Embark on a thrilling puzzle adventure! Maneuver buses through challenging parking lots, match cars with their passengers, and clear the path. Unlock unique vehicles, tackle puzzles of all difficulty levels, and use boosters to sort or shuffle when needed. With vibrant graphics and creative gameplay, this game offers fun for players of all ages!

title: Uphill Rush 13
description: Introducing the new, thirteenth game in the Uphill Rush series, and this time in a new setting - a Water Park! Dive into (pun intended) the atmosphere of water fun, riding different types of tubes, surfboards and even jet skis! Unlock new power-ups and skins by overcoming obstacles, such as loops and long jumps. But don't be scared of them, they are your best friends when it comes to stunts, which give you bonuses! Not to mention, make you look insanely cool.

title: PopSortica
description:
PopSortica is a new chapter in Poppy’s adventures! Join the underwater SORTING voyage! Challenging yet relaxing levels await as you sort things out.
The rules are simple, but the difficulty increases with each new level.
Special obstacles and conditions will challenge your skills, while boosters will help you achieve the best results faster.
Dive deep with Mermaid Poppy and challenge yourself in this exciting sea sorting adventure!

title: Drift Boss
description: In Drift Boss, master the art of controlled chaos as your car hurtles towards the top left corner, requiring your precise clicks or taps to execute perfect drifts to the top right. Anticipate tight spots, earn daily rewards, unlock new car skins through lootboxes, and gear up for the upcoming Easter holidays with an exclusive skin pack.

title: Block Blaster Puzzle
description: Aim for high scores or complete level objectives. Rotate and arrange blocks to clear rows and columns while enjoying stunning visuals. Each perfect move brings satisfaction, challenging you to beat your best and master each puzzle!

title: Christmas Merge
description:
The winter season has returned, and the North Pole is bustling with excitement! Get ready for festive fun with Christmas Merge!

The elves are in a frenzy, scrambling to match presents in time—merge them quickly before the frost sets in!

How many Santas can you create in one go? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Jungle Temple Blast
description:
Hidden deep in the jungle stands an ancient structure known among explorers as the Crystal Temple. Stories say it holds an unimaginable trove of gems and jewels - but only the best puzzle solvers can help themselves to its riches.
Blast your way through hundreds of clever match 3 puzzles, crush gems and jewels, explore the secret jungle temple and recover ancient riches in this exciting treasure hunt adventure!

title: Halloween Merge Mania
description: Halloween Merge Mania is a fast-paced casual game with a fun Halloween vibe. Cute monster balls—pumpkins, black cats, mummies, vampires, and other iconic characters—appear on the screen. Your task is to merge identical creatures to create new, rarer, and more valuable ones. Each successful merge unlocks the next level of spooky yet adorable monsters, while the dark background and vivid graphics immerse you in the festive autumn atmosphere.

title: DIY Makeup Salon - SPA Makeover Studio
description:
Have you ever dreamt of becoming a fashionable DIY make-up stylist in the beauty makeup artist’s salon?

Welcome to the DIY Makeup Salon: SPA Makeover- a fascinating beauty salon game, where you can create fun-filled makeovers for pretty girls! You can showcase your skills as a make-up stylist in our salon. Make use of various tools and facial cleansers to give your model a refreshing skin makeover. There are numerous dress up designs to explore for a flawless make up look!

title: Hexa
description: Hexa is the latest version of the popular puzzle game Hexa Fever. In this strategic addictive game, you have to fill the lines of the hexagon with blocks to remove the whole line and gain gems. Enjoy the challenge and fun of this summer-themed puzzle adventure.

title: Hypermarket 3D: Store Cashier
description:
Step into the world of retail and build the supermarket of your dreams! 

Manage customers, run the cash register, stock shelves, and keep your store thriving. From scanning groceries to cart-surfing adventures, every task brings your bustling market to life.

Take charge as the supermarket cashier, master time management, and turn your small store into a thriving grocery empire.

title: Sum Master
description: Sum Master is an engaging and challenging number puzzle game designed to enhance your mental arithmetic and logical reasoning skills. The objective is to select numbers within a grid so that the sums of each row, column, and colored region match the specified targets. Each puzzle has a unique solution, requiring players to carefully consider which numbers to include or exclude. The game offers a stimulating experience that combines fun with educational value.

title: 4 Hexa
description: 4 Hexa is a fun, colorful online puzzle game! Merge same-number blocks to reach higher scores in this addictive math trivia challenge. Perfect for fans of block match games and brain teasers! Play now and test your skills!

title: Halloween Store Sort
description: In Halloween Store Sort, match spooky toys and Halloween decorations by dragging them between shelves. Create sets of three to clear the shelves and reveal hidden ones above or to the sides of the screen. With many levels and increasing difficulty, each level has a time limit, so think fast! Use the shuffle button if you get stuck. Complete all levels to win and become the ultimate Halloween sorting champion!

title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
description: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck. But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks!

title: Brainrot Clicker
description:
Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious and chaotic idle clicker game that plunges you into a bizarre world of meme-fueled madness. Your mission is simple: tap the screen to earn “Italian Brainrot Points” and unlock increasingly ridiculous AI-generated characters from the internet’s wildest corners.

With eye-catching visuals, meme-inspired humor, and endless upgrades, Brainrot Clicker offers a weirdly satisfying experience you won’t want to stop!

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: Brainrot Mega Parkour
description: Step into the wildest parkour adventure yet. Brainrot Mega Parkour brings together four intense modes, forty handcrafted levels, and a cast of hilarious characters in a single high-speed package. Whether you’re climbing an endless tower, racing across a platform full of traps, escaping a rolling lava ball, or surviving a lava flood, every level pushes your reflexes and timing to the limit.

title: Home Pin 2
description:
Welcome to chapter 2 of the Home Pin. Start your adventure of the pin world in the secret manor!

You want to protect the family? You want to create your own manor and restore the beautiful manor to its former glory? Play Home Pin 2: Family Adventure now - a unique pull pin game with a family storyline you can’t ignore. No more fake ads, this is the game you are looking for!

title: Ninja Obby Parkour
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Ninja Obby Parkour, where every level is a test of speed, agility, and strategy. Packed with hundreds of unique obstacle courses, this game combines competitive racing with ninja-style combat and dazzling customization options.

From smashing glass doors at checkpoints with your ninja power to unlocking powerful bonuses like speed boost, giant mode, and flight, every run feels fresh.

title: Click Click Clicker
description: Click Click Clicker is a single-player, idle clicker game where you earn money by clicking the button on the screen. Unlock various buttons, cursor styles, themes, and music.

title: Block Blast 2048
description: Block Blast 2048 is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you merge blocks with the same number to create higher values. Keep merging to boost your score and face increasing challenges. How far can you go? Can you reach the ultimate block? Play now and test your puzzle skills!

title: Bubble Trouble
description:
Avoid and pop the bubbles! Shoot the bubbles with your harpoon and split them in smaller bubbles, until eventually they disappear.
The classic arcade game from 2002, remastered.
Bubble Trouble (later Bubble Struggle) has been played hundreds of millions of times, labeled 'one of the top 10 online games'.

22 unique levels, for 1 or 2 players (on the same keyboard).
Final boss level.
Challenge other player's scores.

title: Balls and Bricks
description: If you're looking for a simple and no frills fun, then you're in the right place. Bricks vs. Balls is a relaxing game where you just aim and watch as everything gets destroyed. That is, if your aim is on point, but that's about the only catch. Are your ready to try your aim and have lots of fun? Then jump in and play!

title: Butterfly Sort Puzzle
description:
Various kinds of butterflies sitting on leaves.
Shy butterflies can only fly next to friends of the same kind.
Bring its friends to one leaf and fly them together~

title: Hexa Tap Away
description: Hexa Tap Away is a sleek one-direction hex puzzle. Drag tiles to move them in the only direction they can travel, create space, and clear the board. Each level adds trickier layouts, blockers, and tight corridors that demand planning ahead. Short, snackable stages, smooth controls, and a clean look make it easy to start and hard to stop. Stuck? Try a hint or rethink your route and there’s always a smarter move!

title: 2048 Match Balls
description: With super simple rules and addictive gameplay, this logic game offers endless fun while challenging your brain. Merge balls and level up. Each merge increases the value of the balls while also changing their color and size. Be smart and dive into a vibrant world of numbers!

title: Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary
description: Welcome to Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary – the place where your style dreams come to life! Step into the shoes of a talented fashion designer, build your own boutique, and create stunning outfits that dazzle the world. From fabric to final look, you’re in charge of every stitch!

title: Yoga Master
description:
Yoga is a great way to improve your quality of life. It is also a great way to entertain yourself in this game: Yoga Master.

Yoga Master is an addictive 3D running game with different levels that will challenge even the fastest reflex.

title: Little Dentist Dash
description: Little Dental Dash is a charming clinic management where you step into the role of a friendly dentist helping kids with their dental problems. From fixing chipped teeth to carefully placing braces, each patient brings a new challenge that tests your speed and attention to detail. Treat your young patients, keep them smiling, and earn rewards for your excellent work.

title: Find the Vampire
description: Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

title: World Solitaire -Tripeaks-
description:
It is TriPeaks, one of the most famous solitaires in the world.
Take a step to go up and test your brain and luck
How far can I clean it?

title: Lumber Factory Simulator
description:
Welcome to "Lumber Mill Simulator"! This is an exciting game where you own a sawmill.
Your success depends on your ability to make informed decisions, effectively manage resources and grow your business. Are you ready to become a great lumber tycoon?

title: Coin Stack Up
description:
Coin Stack Up is a colorful and satisfying puzzle game where strategy meets stacking fun!
Connect and stack coins of the same color to create powerful combinations and clear the board.
To make a valid move, you must connect at least 3 coins of the same color. The bigger the stack, the better the results! Each level comes with specific goals shown at the top of the screen - plan your moves carefully to complete them before you run out of moves.

title: Draw Climber
description:
Funniest race you ever played ! Draw your legs to win the race!
Any drawing will make you run !
When you are stuck you can draw another shape to pass!

title: Burger Here
description: From a small restaurant to a burger empire! Serve customers, clean tables, hire the best staff and deliver orders on time. Make each burger a masterpiece that everyone will crave. Expand to 4 restaurants and attract more customers.

title: Geometry Dash Maze Maps
description: Welcome to one of the funniest and coolest skill games - Geometry Dash Maze map. Here, you will dive into the fun and amazing world of geometric shapes. Your character will become a cool glowing square with a big smile. In the game, you will help the square overcome all obstacles. To do this, you will need all your dexterity and cunning, because a difficult path awaits you ahead. Be careful and try to click quickly to make the jump in time. Think over all actions and prepare for the next jump,

title: Jigsolitaire
description: Step into a peaceful world of beautiful images made from gentle, carefully crafted blocks. Jigsolitaire is a game you’ll want to return to every day: it helps you unwind, disconnect from stress, and enjoy a small moment of calm just for yourself. Each level reveals a new scene - warm landscapes, charming cottages, delicate nature details, and quiet corners you’ll love exploring piece by piece.

title: Tunnel Road
description: Tunnel Road is an adrenaline-filled arcade game that requires quick reflexes, sharp focus and a great visual reaction! Keep up with the speed, avoid obstacles and cover the longest distance while advancing in a colorful and dynamic tunnel!

title: Winter Hexa Stack
description: Winter Hexa Stack is a cozy and addictive winter-themed puzzle game where you clear the board by stacking three matching hex tiles. Tap a tile to place it in an empty spot or on top of a similar tile. When you match three identical tiles, they disappear and free up valuable space. Be careful—if your holding slots fill up or the timer runs out, the level ends. Plan your moves, stay organized, and enjoy a relaxing winter atmosphere.

title: Rescue Hero
description: The hero begins his journey for treasure and save princess, but the puzzles in front of the hunter trapped him. What you need to do is to pull the pins in the right order, so that the hero can take the hidden treasure and save princess away from dragon, wolf and monster safely.

title: Put the fruit together!
description: A game in the genre of "Connect the Balls" and "2048". Stack identical fruits to combine them into a new larger fruit! The game has incredibly beautiful and cute graphics, nice music accompaniment and addictive gameplay!

title: Emergency Jam
description: As you progress, encounter cars in 8 different colors, adding complexity to your strategy. Use powerful boosters to line up characters by color or shuffle vehicles, clearing the way more efficiently. Test your logic, think fast, and rescue passengers.

title: Magic Piano Music
description: Ready to become a piano master? In Magic Piano Music, tap the magic tiles to follow the beats and play your favorite music. Follow the rhythm of the music and click with precision, don't miss any notes. The game will end after three misses. There's tons of music here like classic piano music, pop music and more! Every song will take you on an immersive arcade rhythm adventure.

title: Knit Bears
description: Knit Bears is a cozy and colorful puzzle game where you help adorable teddy bears come to life by knitting them from soft yarn. Choose a bear, place it in the center, and matching yarn balls will start wrapping it up. Each teddy bear needs three yarns to be fully knitted, so plan your moves carefully. If the board fills with unfinished bears that can’t be completed, the game ends.

title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
description: Zombies have taken over the world! Unlock bases and deploy soldiers with unique weapons, each with stats like damage, fire rate, and reload speed. Soldiers must reload at the base before defending. Place them wisely to stop zombies within range. Defeat waves to earn coins, upgrade bases, and survive stronger hordes. Strategically choose soldiers to clear waves and save cities across the globe.

title: Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat!
description: Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat is an exciting and relaxing puzzle game that will test your strategic thinking and planning skills!

title: MineTap Merge Clicker
description:
MineTap is an idle clicker with merge mechanics and crafting. Also there is an adventure, where you can fight zombies and other monsters and even build your own village!

Enjoy mining and treasure hunting. Complete quests and level up your character. Craft your ultimate weapon and slay epic monsters!
Have you ever had a dream to be a hero and save the world? Then tap to play and become a legend of crafting.
Start your epic mining adventure right now - click, tap & rock!

title: Steal Brainrot Arena
description: Steal Brainrot Arena is a fast-paced collection and heist game where every match turns into a battle of wallets, wits, and sneaky steals. Play solo in 1 Player mode or team up and compete in 2 Player mode as you build the ultimate Brainrot lineup. With over 45+ brainrot characters to discover, your goal is simple: buy better Brainrots, earn more, and create the most stacked collection in the arena.

title: Block Pixels
description:
Block Pixels is a vibrant puzzle game where classic block-clearing action meets the creative joy of pixel art discovery.

Your main goal is to strategically place colorful pieces to clear lines on the board. But the real magic lies in what you clear. Each block you eliminate contributes to a larger masterpiece. Clearing specific colors helps you build and reveal dozens of charming hidden images, from cute animals to fun objects.

title: Block Puzzle - Frozen Jewel
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle
description: Play Color Sort Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts free online and challenge your mind in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Unscrew, swap, and organize bolts by color in a satisfying logic puzzle that works as a focused brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart, addictive sorting fun anytime.

title: My Arcade Center
description: My Arcade Center is a fast-paced management game where you build and expand your own arcade. Earn tokens by day, upgrade machines by night, hire staff, use coin bots, and handle freeloaders and vandals. Unlock new machines, optimize layouts, manage customer behavior, and progress through 9 handcrafted maps for long-term growth.

title: Ice Cream Inc.
description:
Ice Cream Simulator is a satisfying casual game where you step into the shoes of a master ice cream artist. Your goal is to run the most popular shop in town by creating the ice cream of your dreams!

From classic Vanilla and Dark Chocolate to fruity Mango and Juicy Strawberry, you have all the ingredients needed to create the perfect frozen treat. Whether your customers want a soft-serve cone, ice cream rolls, frozen yogurt, or traditional Gelato, it’s up to you to serve them with a smile.

title: Italian Brainrot Survive Parkour
description: Step into the absurd universe of Italian Brainrot Survive Parkour, where chaos, memes, and tricky obstacle runs collide! Pick your favorite Brainrot characters, master wild parkour tracks, and survive each hilarious stage with your reflexes and timing.

title: Panda Kitchen Idle Tycoon
description: Want to become the best restaurant tycoon? You’ll build your own panda-themed food empire in Panda Kitchen: Idle Tycoon. Earn idle profits, and manage your way to success. Unlock new dining tables and kitchen equipment to improve efficiency. Recruiting chefs and servers to create an ultra-efficient restaurant team.

title: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance
description: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance is an exhilarating adventure game that merges the thrill of intricate prison escape challenges with the dynamic agility required in parkour. Assume the role of a resourceful rat striving to escape the strict surveillance of a heavily fortified prison. Find your way through elaborate mazes and overcome diverse, challenging obstacles as you plot your daring prison escape.

title: Word Deck Solitaire
description: WordDeck: Solitaire is a relaxing browser-based word puzzle game that combines solitaire-style card interaction with logical word associations. Clear the board by finding groups of related words and sorting them into hidden categories. Each level challenges you to identify connections between words based on themes, objects, properties, or concepts. As you progress, puzzles become more complex with larger word sets and subtler relationships.

title: Idle Trade Isle
description: Idle Trade Isle is a casual simulation game. Let's go on an island adventure on the sea! You are a captain, driving a boat to the mysterious island group. Each island has different natural resources that need to be collected. After collecting them, go back to your own island to build and upgrade them.  Enjoy!

title: Liquids Sort Puzzle
description:
Colorful, bubbling, fragrant, and iridescent concoctions fill flasks, jugs, and test tubes in varying proportions!

Figure out strategy and create harmony by collecting liquids of different colors and properties in different containers!

Test your attention and reasoning skills in this meditative puzzle game. 

Many levels of increasing difficulty and bonus tasks await you! 

Excellent attention training and good mood guaranteed!

title: ChickZ Stack
description:
ChickZ Stack is a fun and addictive arcade game where flying chickens take to the sky! stack your chickens to overcome obstacles and glide through colorful, challenging levels.

The taller your chicken stack, the easier it is to pass walls, traps, and enemies.

Unlock adorable flying chickens, explore new worlds, and compete for high scores.

With simple one-tap controls and fast-paced gameplay, ChickZ Stack is easy to play but hard to master.

Stack, fly, and flap your way to victory!

title: Fish Eat Grow Mega
description: The mega grow is beginning with the mega fishes in the huge ocean on a great exciting adventure! New types of fish and a huge ocean are waiting for you in this chapter. Swimming in the more dangerous places of the ocean must be exciting. Pick your fish and embark on this adventure with your friend in 2 player game mode. Grow as much as you can and become the king fish of the ocean!

title: Candy Crusher
description: Crush down the candy to become king of candies. Match 3 or more of the same candies together to remove them from play. Match 4 or 5 candies together to unlock bonus candies. Try to score as many points as possible within the limited amount of moves given. Level up to unlock additional board space in this fun online Candy Crush game.

title: Zumble Ocean
description: Get better at one of the most popular puzzle games. Shoot gems and try to complete all the levels with three stars in each level. This gem game is easy to play and addicting at the same time.

title: Wood & Screw Puzzle
description: Welcome to the Wood & Screw Puzzle, where the world of puzzles meets the thrill of fasteners! Embark on a thrilling adventure where bolts, nuts, and wooden puzzles collide in a mind-bending challenge. Dive into a world filled with conundrums, where every turn reveals a new twist in the game.

title: Halloween Fruit Slice
description: Halloween Fruit Slice is a high-energy arcade action game set in a spooky Halloween world. Vivid fruits and devious traps streak across the screen in an instant. Your task is to slice as many fruits as possible with lightning speed, chaining spectacular combos and racking up points while dodging explosive bombs. Rich visuals, splashy juice effects, and eerie backdrops create a thrilling, immersive atmosphere. The tempo keeps rising, so every moment tests your reflexes and precision.

title: Tung Tung Sahur in Geometry Dash
description: Join Tung Tung Sahur, the wooden drum-carrying dawn caller, as he bounces and flips through a neon cityscape just before sunrise! Dodge spikes, leap over traps, and time your jumps to the beat of his signature “tung-tung!” calls. In this Geometry Dash–inspired challenge, the streets are alive with glowing gates, speed pads, and tricky gravity flips. Can you drum your way to the end without missing a beat?

title: Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up
description: Dress up your paper doll with mystical styles in Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up! ?✨ Get ready to enter a dreamy world where fantasy meets fashion. This isn’t just a dress-up game—it’s your magical escape, where every outfit tells a story and every style reveals a spellbound secret. Whether you're a fashion dreamer, a lover of magic, or a diary keeper at heart, this enchanted adventure is made just for you.

title: Steal Brainrot Eggs
description: Steal Brainrot Eggs is a competitive action game playable in both 1 Player and 2 Player modes. Players buy eggs from a central conveyor, carry them to their Base, and hatch random Brainrot characters based on egg rarity. Characters generate coins over time, allowing access to higher-tier eggs. Defend your Base from thieves or steal eggs and characters from rivals, customize your character, raise evolving pets, and take part in timed events across the map.

title: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game
description: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game lets you become the ultimate nail artist! Step into your very own nail salon where creativity has no limits. Design stunning acrylic nails with trendy styles, vibrant colors, and charming accessories. Satisfy your customers' unique requests, earn money, and upgrade your salon to become the best nail stylist in town!

title: Darling Doll
description: Darling Doll is the ultimate paper doll DIY game that offers a perfect blend of character creation and dress-up game. With a vast collection of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles, you can unleash your creativity and design unique avatars that reflect your personal style. Whether you prefer chibi dolls or glamorous fashion dolls, Darling Doll has got you covered.

title: Super Hero Tycoon
description: Build your superhero empire and dominate the battlefield! In Super Hero Tycoon, choose from iconic heroes like Iron Man, Spider-Man, or The Hulk, and construct your base to generate income, unlock powerful gear, and engage in thrilling PvP combat. With over 2 billion visits, this game offers an immersive experience for fans of superheroes and tycoon-style gameplay.

title: Color Strings
description: Looking for a simple way to exercise your brain every day? Try Color Strings! This game features straightforward rules and fun, challenging gameplay. In this puzzle game, you need to rearrange the strings on the dots to match the given pattern. With various puzzle levels, you'll keep your brain sharp in just a few minutes each day.

title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: Capybara Xmas Merge
description:
Capybara Xmas Merge is a cute and cozy holiday game where you combine adorable Christmas capybaras!
Drop festive capybaras into the box, watch them roll and bump into each other, and merge into bigger, funnier holiday characters.
Create giant capybaras, score points, and enjoy the warm winter atmosphere.

title: Mutant run
description: When you are running on a track full of various obstacles, you need to choose to go through the mutation gate to evolve your body, gain the talents of specific animals, and clear the obstacles in the road!

title: Connect Balls New Year Puzzles!
description: ● This New Year's game is more difficult than it might seem ?! You have a playing field? on which you need to throw balls and connect the same ones??! Until you get the biggest and most beautiful one?! Save up points?! Compete with friends and colleagues to become the best?! Enjoy your game?!

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Dino Game
description: Play Dino Game online! An offline-style dinosaur run for 1–3 players. Jump cacti, dodge flyers, unlock dinos, and race for high scores. Dino Game brings the classic offline dinosaur run to life with fast, responsive gameplay and local multiplayer. Dash across an endless desert, jump over cacti, and duck under swooping dinos as the speed steadily climbs. Play solo to beat your personal best, or switch to 2-player and 3-player modes to race friends on the same device.

title: Snow Rush 3D
description:
Snow Rush 3D is a fun sledding game that tests speed and reflexes for winter sports enthusiasts, playable in both 1 and 2 players! Try to reach the longest distance by overcoming obstacles and ramps on a challenging snow-covered track, or challenge your friend!

Snowmen, obstacles and tricky turns await you along the way. How far can you go and how many gifts can you collect?

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes

title: Max Mixed Cocktails
description: Do you want to become a master mixologist? Create cocktails by blending ingredients at the bar. Choose your ingredients, mix them skillfully, and sample the concoction. You'll reach a delightful conclusion by discovering the perfect recipe. Utilize clues in the collections to unlock different endings.

title: Jewel Magic Xmas
description: Already in Christmas mood The classic turn based triplet matching arcade with Christmas decorations awaits you Match triplets while solving puzzles in lots of different challenging levels Also you can spin the lucky wheel daily to get boosters to help you Have a jolly time Merry matching Christmas with jolly jewels

title: Shanghai Chef
description:
A fun and fast-paced matching game where you need to find and connect the same blocks! 
Test your reflexes and observation skills as you quickly spot matching pairs. 
Can your hands move faster than your eyes can track? 
Pay close attention to which blocks can be linked together and clear the board as fast as possible!

title: Worm Escape
description:
Worm Escape is a fun puzzle game that tests your logic and decision-making skills. Move worms in the correct order to clear each level. A single right move can solve the puzzle, while a wrong one can block your progress.

As you advance, levels become more complex with tighter spaces and more worms. Analyze carefully and choose the right sequence to succeed.

Simple tap controls make it easy to play, but mastering each level requires planning and strategy.

title: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner
description:
Become a legendary kunai master in this thrilling combination of dynamic gameplay and classic ninja action. Play offline and enjoy the freedom to dive into the adventure whenever you want. Slice through foes, overcome obstacles, and set out on an epic ninja quest without boundaries.

Will you seize the blade and claim your place as the ultimate ninja warrior?

title: Word Rivers
description: Play Word Rivers - an exciting word game where you can enjoy a sea of words and fantastic crosswords. Find words from letters and discover the wonders of the world and words right now!

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Table Tennis Open
description: Discover a casual, easy-to-play game for hours of endless fun. Face off against your opponent, bounce the ball as its speed increases, and aim for the highest score. Earn coins with each hit to upgrade your racket!

title: Nonogram Picture Cross
description:
Discover the mystery of picture cross number puzzles! Solve the nonogram puzzles with simple rules and challenging solutions to uncover the picture! Exercise your logic with a picture cross game and become a real Nonogram master!  
  
Nonograms are addictive number puzzles that combine logic with pixel art. Reveal hidden pictures on the puzzle pages based on the numbers lined up in both directions! To solve the picture cross puzzle, follow the clues that will help you color the squares to complete the line and choose which of them have to stay empty. If you fill in all the right squares in this pic cross puzzle, you will uncover a lovely pixel art picture! This is the main point of the picture cross quiz.

title: Crunch Locked
description: Crunch Locked is a satisfying puzzle game where every move brings the pieces closer together. Tap available segments to snap them into place and gradually build complete shapes. As the structure collapses into a single remaining piece, the final segment crunches away and clears the level. With locked parts, blocked paths, and increasingly clever layouts, every puzzle requires careful planning and the right sequence of moves.

title: Emoji Drop Themes
description: Dive into the addictive fun of Emoji Drop, a delightful physics puzzle game where strategy meets chain reactions! Drop a variety of charming items, from classic emojis and juicy fruits to wild animals into the container. The magic happens when two matching items touch, merging into something new and bigger. With a challenging Adventure Mode and a relaxing Classic Mode, can you master the merge and discover the final, ultimate item?

title: Jump Master
description:
You can jump further if you press down on the marker.
Press and release the timing so that it doesn't fall between the footrest and the footrest!
Why don't you compete with your friends for points with the sharing function?

title: Aliens Hunter
description: You are an alien hunter and your mission is to use your abilities to find the aliens hidden in the city and use your gun to accurately shoot the aliens to get rewards. Each round has different aliens hiding in different locations. You have to accurately choose, aim and shoot to complete the level mission.

title: Brainrots Lava Survive Online
description: Brainrots Lava Survive Online is an intense survival experience where rising lava transforms the map into a dangerous obstacle zone. Players must collect brainrots in risky areas and escape before the lava blocks safe routes. Online mode is available in 1 Player, allowing chat and interaction, while 2 Player mode offers local shared-screen competition. With more than 60 characters in normal, gold, diamond, Celestial, and time-limited Divine tiers, progression stays dynamic.

title: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Rooms
description: Immerse yourself in a game where the process of coloring becomes truly meditative. Create and decorate houses as a designer. Just touch the screen and the colors will match the numbers in the image. Forget about boring routine - now you are thinking about color combinations. For even more relaxation, a music player has been added.

title: Chicken Scream Race
description: Get ready for a wacky and challenging voice-controlled adventure in Chicken Scream Race! This unique game brings a hilarious twist to platform racing by letting you control your character with both taps and your voice. Whether you’re clucking quietly or screaming loudly, your chicken responds to the intensity of your sound, making each race a chaotic yet exciting experience.

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker
description: Get ready for the cutest twist on the viral Brainrot universe! Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker is the baby-themed sequel to the hit Brainrot Clicker! Tap your way through the baby versions of your favorite characters, collect upgrades, and enjoy a whole new atmosphere with colorful visuals, cheerful music, and fresh sound effects designed to fit the playful baby theme!

title: Geometry Rush 4D
description: Geometry Rush 4D is an exhilarating 4D platformer that takes speed, precision, and reflexes to the next level. In this fast-paced, action-packed game, you guide a customizable character through vibrant, geometric worlds filled with intricate obstacles and dynamic traps. The game's signature dash mechanic allows players to perform rapid movements, weaving through ever-changing environments with seamless control.

title: Beach Club
description:
Calm down and manage your Beach Club!
Relax while listening to the waves, the ocean and some gulls. And soon you'll feel like you're floating around at the beach...
Let your helpers do all the work, stroll through the sand and collect the money from your customers.
Unlock new stuff so that even more people will come to your beach :D

Buy more seats, expand your beach and build your own empire!
Get some clean towels and make your Beach Club the most beautiful place.

title: Cargo Skates
description:
No obstacles, no matter how high, can stop me from collecting more goods.
Pass the obstacles and finally collect enough goods.
Now, your supermarket can open

title: Chibi Doll - Avatar Creator
description:
Street - it's no matter build your modern city life or just stick with village-like town world you always be enjoy with it! 

Room - decorate and design home girly world.

Gacha - unlock countless gachapon surprises your lovely avatar, bring gacha to your fantasy life! 

Dress Up Games - match and mix more than 5000+ girly items for dressing up princess: hairstyle, clothes, hats, accessories, freckles, moles, blush, wings, tails.

title: Tiny Cars
description: Tiny Cars is a colorful arcade traffic management game where players must avoid collisions. With a top-down view and engaging gameplay, this game features 50 base stages set in various locations like crossroads, squares, and highways. After completing the initial 50 levels, players will encounter the same environments with increased difficulty, offering a challenging and addictive experience for traffic control enthusiasts. Enjoy managing the traffic and becoming a master of Tiny Cars, the ultimate arcade traffic management game!

title: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots
description: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots is a fast and rewarding collection game where action, risk, and strategy come together. Your mission is to break brainrot eggs, collect rare Brainrot characters, and safely deliver them to your base before time runs out. Each run is a mix of decision making and reflex.

title: Two Dots Remastered
description: Welcome to Two Dots Remastered, a fun and popular HTML5 connecting game enjoyed by gamers of all ages! Two Dot Remastered’s gameplay is straightforward: Match two or more dots in the same color (not diagonal ones) and then blast them! Enjoy playing Two Dots Remastered, the ultimate connecting game for gamers of all ages, and become a master at connecting dots!

title: Jewels Classic
description:
Jewels Classic is a match-3 game with a mystery theme! Match three or more of the same gems to clear them from the level. Use boosters to create epic combos and reap the rewards of chests and more!

There is no timer in Jewels Classic. That means you can take your time to select the best gem matches for the most points. To earn more points, complete more difficult gem matches. Instead of just three-of-a-kinds, try to make four-of-a-kinds, five-of-a-kinds, and even L-shaped matches. The game ends
when you run out of moves.

Jewels Classic trains important brain skills including visual acuity and concentration. Play now to prove your multifaceted skills and compete against the world in leaderboards for the top score!

title: Galaxy Clicker
description: Explore space in Galaxy Clicker, a free online game where you travel through galaxies with just a click. Play on your phone or computer and enjoy a relaxing space adventure that tests your strategy while keeping you entertained.

title: Phone Case DIY Run
description: Phone Case DIY Run is a very fun simulation game. What type of phone case do you have now? If you are interested in making a phone case, then come and join us to learn about the process! Collect the models, choose your favorite color for painting, then paste the picture and choose the pendant. Finally, the more phone cases you collect when you reach the end, the more money you get. Have fun!

title: Sand Sort: Color Puzzle Game
description: Dive into Sand Sorting Challenge, the ultimate relaxing color sort puzzle! Tap, pour, and organize vibrant sand into beautiful bottles. This easy-to-play game adds a fresh twist to classic color sorting puzzles, combining soothing gameplay with a fun challenge that will test your focus and strategy. Can you fill every bottle with the right color and master the art of color sand sorting?

title: Slinky Color Sort
description: Slinky Color Sort Puzzle is a relaxing color-therapy game where you sort bright slinky rings into matching stacks. Easy to play yet surprisingly challenging, it’s perfect for calming down while keeping your brain active. Enjoy smooth gameplay, colorful levels, and satisfying logic puzzles.

title: Tropical Cubes 2048
description: A game in the genre of 2048. Skillfully use the game physics to your advantage. The goal of the game is to connect the cubes to the maximum number 2048 and not to lose. There is a booster in the game, which will make it fun and easier to pass the game.

title: Foxy Eco Sort
description:
Join Foxy and Raccoon on their eco-mission! Sort waste, play match-3 and matching pairs to clean polluted locations. 

But it's not just cleaning! Uncover the conspiracy of cunning Ratty who wants to destroy the forest. Complete story chapters: track garbage trucks, expose arsonists and save your home!

title: Block Puzzle - Jewel Forest
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Find Objects - Hidden Item
description:
Find objects on colorful maps with links and Easter eggs!
An interesting puzzle casual indie game in the genres of "Hidden Objects" and "Find the Differences"!

Embark on an exciting journey through beautiful 2D locations, where hundreds of hidden objects and riddles await you! Explore picturesque landscapes, mysterious cities and magical worlds to find all the hidden objects. And in the "Spot the Difference" mode, test your attentiveness by comparing two almost identical pictures!

title: SuperPixelint
description:
It's a game where you draw a cute little image.
You can develop color matching skills and accuracy without any burden.
Why don't you get out of your daily life for a while and heal yourself through coloring games?

title: Hero Transform Race
description: Hero Transform Race is an action-packed and fun parkour game that transforms you from an ordinary person into a legendary superhero. Your goal is to reach the end of the track by transforming into the appropriate superhero form for the obstacles you encounter!

title: Darts King
description: Square off against your opponents in a game of skill and precision. Progress in leagues and prove time and time again you're the best darts player. Upgrade your darts and create your own very unique set.

title: Mini Golf Saga
description: Embark on an immersive golf adventure with Mini Golf Saga, a captivating 3D mini-golf game set against the backdrop of a picturesque beach, featuring diverse golf levels where precision is key to achieving the lowest hit count for a high score; facing limited hits per level, strategize your shots wisely and, when needed, watch a rewarded video ad to replenish your chances and continue the saga of sun-soaked golfing excitement.

title: Candy Tile Blast
description: Candy Tile Blast is a fun and addictive matching game. Tap two or more of the same tiles to blast them out. Collect all the required tiles to pass the levels!

title: Hole Puzzle
description: Hole Puzzle is a fun and addictive casual game where a hungry cat with a magical black-hole mouth is ready to eat everything in sight! Move across colorful levels, collect tasty food, complete objectives, and grow bigger with every bite. Easy to play, satisfying to master, and packed with charming visuals, exciting challenges, and endless food-collecting fun. Can you become the biggest hungry kitty of all?

title: Ball Drop
description: Embark on a thrilling journey with Ball Drop, where your objective is to guide the bouncing ball safely through a series of perilous obstacles while avoiding deadly spikes. With its captivating minimalist design, responsive gameplay, immersive music, and 32 challenging levels, this game promises an addictive experience that will keep you hooked for hours.

title: College Girls Team Makeover
description: Try our new fashionista app "College Girls Team Makeover". Here you can dress up 5 high school best friends. They are the most popular school girls and always together. Everyone would like to be in their girl squad! They manage to be the most stylish girls in school, because they have their own fashion stylist and that’s you! You can control their whole look from the color of their skin and eyes to hairstyle and makeup. More than 1000 items of clothes and accessories are at your disposal!

title: Italian Brainrot Clicker
description: Italian Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious one-button idle clicker that throws you into the chaotic charm of the Italian Brainrot universe. Fueled by Gen-Z meme culture and AI-generated madness, this game unleashes a world of mutant creatures and meme-fueled mayhem. From dancing cappuccinos to cactus-bodied elephants, every tap pulls you deeper into a spiral of satire and brainrot. It is weird, it is wild, and it is wonderfully addictive. You will not believe what you are unlocking next!

title: Arrow Sorting
description: Arrow! Sorting Food is a satisfying puzzle adventure where every move changes the board. Tap the arrows to unravel colorful fruit chains, clear paths, and untangle tricky patterns across countless levels. Unlock new visual themes, collect fun skins, and enjoy relaxing yet brain-teasing gameplay that grows more challenging with every stage. Simple to learn, surprisingly addictive to master!

title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
description:
In this physics-based innovative puzzle game, your objective is to strategically place screws and nuts to fall all the wooden blocks.
Unleash your cognitive ability as you tackle each brain-teasing level, each one designed to test your problem-solving skills. From simple puzzles to complex constructions, this 2D puzzle game offers an array of challenges suitable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.

title: Obby Parkour Racing
description:
Welcome to Obby Parkour Racing – the game where speed, agility, and style collide to create the ultimate racing challenge!

Jump, grind, and dodge through dynamic obstacle courses on your snowboard! Prove your mastery in a world where parkour isn't just on foot
it's on a board. Every race is a new test, and only the fastest and most agile champions will claim victory.

title: Home Island
description:
Looking for a family adventure game? Try our Home Island: Family Pin free puzzle games about village life in paradise island! Pull the pin to solve the puzzle, follow the story and enjoy adventures on the island.
On the adventure for discovering the new island, a family cruise ship plane had to face an accident because of the bad weather. The father has gone missing, but the mother and their daughter luckily survived and got to a strange island.

title: Antistress Relaxation Box
description: Antistress - Relaxation Box is a fun casual game. Have you long been upset with some people in your life? He may be your date or a relative, and this game will vent your dissatisfaction! Choose a character and a tool for hitting, and your task is to beat the blood bar to 0 in a limited time. Easy to pick up, but informative and will give you hours of entertainment. Relax yourself and have fun!

title: Good Sort Master: Triple Match
description:
A new game for those who like to put order on the shelf, in the closet, in the refrigerator. Collect identical items in groups of 3 - sort, arrange, tidy!
Connect items three in a row, create coziness! Cleaning has never been so interesting and fun!
A simple and relaxing game for women and men of all ages!

title: Hidden Easter Egg Hunt
description: Dive into the fun world of Hidden Easter Egg Hunt, a fun and relaxing hidden object game for players of all ages! Explore colorful spring landscapes filled with blooming flowers, green fields, and playful bunnies as you search for hidden Easter eggs scattered around the game board. With charming graphics and a festive feel, this game is perfect for getting into the Easter spirit. Test your observation skills, challenge your attention to detail, and enjoy the joyful hunt!

title: Lazy Dog
description: Jump into this cozy puzzle game and help your adorable pup reunite with his beloved ball! Calculate the angles, time your moves, and draw lines to help the lazy dog catch his beloved ball by guiding it to him with ropes. With satisfying physics, cozy visuals, and challenging puzzles, Lazy Dog is the perfect game for the whole family. No ads, no in app purchases - just pup-tastic fun!

title: Lost Things - Hidden Objects
description:
Embark on an exciting adventure where your powers of observation are your main tool!
This is a relaxing hidden object game created for those who appreciate slow-paced gameplay and enjoy exploring detailed worlds. Forget about time pressure! Here you can explore huge, colorful maps filled with hundreds of artfully hidden objects at your own pace.

title: Archery Master
description: With a dynamic progression system, players unlock powerful bows, master challenging mechanics like wind and moving targets, and climb the leaderboards. From stationary targets to tricky trajectories, each level will test your reflexes and skill.

title: 100 Doors Challenge
description:
Do you like puzzles and hidden object games? Do you play games from the 100 Doors series? Then this point-and-click game is just what you need! Use all your skills to complete all levels and get all achievements.
The main goal in the "100 Doors Challenge" is to get out of the room. Using all the capabilities of the device, you need to open each of the 100 doors and move the elevator to the next floor. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and use objects to do it!

title: Grill Party
description: Welcome to Grill Party! Step into the exciting world of grilling and become a master at crafting tasty skewers! In Grill Party!, you’ll experience a thrilling match-3 puzzle game where you’ll arrange meats, seafood, and veggies to create perfect combos. Serve up mouthwatering treats and show off your grilling skills!

title: Body Care Simulator
description: ASMR Cleaning is a fun simulation game on yad.com. There are four sections: foot spa, manicure, lip care, and clean inside the ear. You will enter a quiet and comfortable environment and experience different care processes. Have fun!

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: Farm Defense
description: Farm Defense is a fast, arcade-style shooter where you guard your ranch from waves of quirky mutants. Move between lanes, aim, and blast anything that crawls out of the burrows before it reaches your crops. Earn coins, unlock new weapons and gadgets, and power up your electric fence. Bright visuals, snappy controls, and escalating waves make every run tense and satisfying.

title: Football Superstars 2026
description: Ready for your next football challenge? Test your skills in a friendly match, or jump right in and lead your dream team in the World Tournament against international teams. Remember, no one ever drowned in sweat!

title: Idle Hotel Empire
description:
Grow your hotel empire in this idle tycoon simulation game.

Construct different hotel floors to suit the needs of your customers. This includes construcing standard hotel rooms, cafe bistros, deluxe rooms, meeting rooms for corporate customers, vip rooms, infinity pools, gym and fitness rooms and of course, the bougee presidential suite.

Control hotel employees, move them up and down the elevators to move the cash, and finally CASH it in the reception office.

title: Passenger Sort
description: Play Passenger Sort free online and take control in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Guide travelers to the right buses, planes, and trains in a clever logic puzzle that works as a fun brain game for all ages. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart sorting challenges anytime.

title: Falling Blocks Puzzle
description: Falling Blocks Puzzle is a timeless puzzle game where players arrange falling geometric shapes, to form complete horizontal lines. As lines are completed, they disappear, and players earn points. The game ends when the stack of shapes reaches the top of the screen. It’s a test of strategy and quick thinking, beloved by gamers worldwide.

title: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run
description: Get ready to dive into the exhilarating world of Shape Transforming: Shifting Run, where the power of transformation is in your hands! This game is a thrilling journey across diverse terrains, challenging players to adapt, transform, and conquer. If you have a knack for quick thinking and love dynamic gameplay, this is the perfect game for you! ??

title: Math Obby
description: Combine your math skills with parkour prowess in Math Obby, an engaging Roblox experience that challenges players with arithmetic problems amidst obstacle courses. Navigate through stages that test both your agility and your knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Earn badges as you progress and showcase your mastery in this educational adventure.

title: Collect Em All
description:
Collect Em All! Is a puzzle game where you connect all the adjacent same colored blocks. Make long chains of colors to create beautiful sounds and unlock explosive power-ups!

Connect the dots to crush them. You can make a limited number of moves, and you cannot go back on yourself, so make sure to plan your path. Create the longest chains for the biggest reward!

 Come back every day to unlock new daily bonuses !

title: Fish Love
description: Save fish from danger, bombs, lava and crab and give the fish just love. They cannot live without each other. Beautiful and pleasant music, sound effects, bright and colorful graphics accompany you through all the puzzles of this game. Start your adventure now. Good luck in love !!!

title: Colossatron
description:
Take charge of a giant robotic snake and smash through cities with ease as you fight to create the most fearsome weapon of all time.
Unleash the power of Colossatron! A unique combination of Match 3 and Snake gameplay allows you to build a devastating machine by merging colored power ups to create new and more powerful weapons. With thousands of potential combinations, the key to victory lies in mastering the art of building Colossatron to take down formidable bosses.

title: Hidden Object Great Journey
description: “Hidden Object: Great Journey” is an engaging game that invites players to scour various themed levels for cleverly concealed items. With multiple modes, a lot of challenges, and a treasure trove of objects to find, this game promises endless fun for hidden object enthusiasts. Sharpen your observation skills and embark on a delightful search with every play!

title: Sprunki Phase Brainrot
description: Sprunki Phase Brainrot is a chaotic and hilarious reskin of the original Sprunki game, now powered by Italian Brainrot energy! Play as absurd meme legends like Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Frigo Camelo, La Vaca Saturno, Lirili Larila, Burbaloni Luliloli, and many more. Run, jump, and lose your mind through surreal levels packed with brainrot humor, crazy visuals, and unpredictable madness. Enjoy custom sound effects and music that match each character’s bizarre personality!

title: Knife Madness
description: Aim, throw and survive! Watch out — avoid hitting other blades. The spinning wheel gets faster, the stakes get higher and only your quick reflexes will keep you in the game. Can you defeat the boss levels and unlock epic knife skins? The challenge is on!

title: Robot Awake
description: Robot Awake is a puzzle game to wake the robots by directing the laser to power them to complete the level. There are 100 challenging levels that get more difficult as you proceed. Can you solve all levels?

title: Idle Factory Domination
description: Embark on a journey of industrial dominance in Idle Factory Domination. Click on cells to purchase land, invest in businesses and resources to initiate production, and steadily expand your empire to unlock new territories, all while amassing wealth and asserting your manufacturing prowess.

title: Magic Finger
description: Magic Finger 3D is a casual physics game where you use your magical powers to defeat alien foes creatively. Use your magic touch to throw enemies at each other, utilize explosive barrels for big impacts, and send adversaries off platforms. Control your surroundings by picking up and manipulating objects, becoming the ultimate magic user.

title: Idle Pizza Business
description: Grow your own pizza empire by hiring staff, expanding your shop, and earning more money in this 3D idle business simulator!

title: Bowling Stars
description: Enjoy a classic game of bowling with simple and fun gameplay. Earning trophies will unlock better bowling balls and help you win against more skilled opponents.

title: Hidden Object Adventure
description: Are you ready to solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets? Become a detective in Find Hidden Object Game and test your observation skills!
